item.summary: Lithuania's Axiology has received an expanded MiFID authorisation from the Bank of Lithuania (Lietuvos bankas) covering the reception, transmission and execution of client orders, according to the company as reported by Kaupr. The firm says the change lets institutions subscribe and redeem units in tokenised money-market funds directly through it. Axiology already operates under the EU DLT Pilot Regime.
